title: Insight Engine user preferences (v2)
description: User-level, cross-session preferences for the Insight Engine adjudication layer. Lives OUTSIDE the plugin (default ~/.insight-engine/preferences.json) so it survives upgrades and is never version-controlled. DOCUMENTATION ONLY: prefs.py does not validate against this file at runtime; migration and coercion live in prefs.py _coerce(). v1 files (schema_version 1, only adjudication.standing_opt_out) are migrated in code: scope all -> offer=off, scope crosslab -> crosslab=off, scope none -> defaults.

schema_version.description: Bumped from 1 to 2 for the switchable-settings block. v1 files are migrated in prefs.py, not rejected.

settings.description: The 13 switchable settings. Every one is operator-changeable, standing and per-run; nothing is centrally locked. Ask-removing / egress-widening / breadth-raise / block-reopen changes require a deliberate --confirm in prefs.py.

offer.description: Whether the Step 10 offer appears at all (off = old opt-out scope 'all').

crosslab.description: Whether cross-lab rung A appears (off = old opt-out scope 'crosslab'; A removed, B/C still offered).

default_rung.description: ask = show the rung menu each run; a fixed value skips the menu with a saved-setting notice.

privilege_ask.description: on = every cross-lab run asks 'privileged?' first; off = standing pre-consent (an in-run privileged flag still blocks).

egress_mode.description: Outbound content: redacted spine / full brief / choose per run. Raw source documents are never sent at any value.

show_outbound_package.description: on = show the exact package for confirm/edit/cancel before any send.

block_override.description: Whether a fired governance block can be overridden by the deliberate typed act; disabled = self-binding until switched back (re-enabling needs --confirm).

rung_consent.description: on = each rung's consent recap (spend/egress/retention/caveat) before dispatch.

crosslab_model.description: Which cross-lab model rung A targets (exported as CROSSLAB_MODEL). Not enum-validated (labs change); verified on the next preflight.

log_overrides.description: Record governance-block overrides in the local monitor; never in the deliverable, never version-controlled. off leaves overrides with no record anywhere.

panel_size.description: Rung-C Opus instances (N). N is the depth axis; runs_per_model is NOT multiplied on top. Above 3 is mostly cost.

crosslab_breadth.description: Distinct cross-lab models on rung A (M). Each added lab is a new counterparty; a raise needs --confirm.

runs_per_model.description: Repeat runs per model (R). auto = M==1 -> R=2 (stability filter), M>=2 -> R=1 each.

meta.description: Per-key provenance: set_on / confirmed / consequence / note. Also the seam an enterprise edition would extend with locked_by.

standing_opt_out.description: DERIVED mirror (recomputed on every save) so older v1 plugins still honour an opt-out. Non-authoritative: settings.offer/crosslab are the source of truth. offer=off -> scope all; else crosslab=off -> scope crosslab; else none.
